coordinateSystem: three.js right-handed, Y up. x = east, z = south (toward the default camera, which looks north), y = height above the ground datum (water level = 0 unless the plan says otherwise).
rotation: yawDeg = rotation about +Y in degrees, three.js convention (Object3D.rotation.y = yawDeg * PI / 180; the piece's front = local +z faces (sin yaw, cos yaw): 0 = south, 90 = east, 180 = north, -90 = west). rotationEulerDeg is the same as [x, y, z] Euler (order XYZ).
transform: lab placement: world matrix = compose(position, rotationY(yawDeg), scale) * the lab GLB mesh node matrix (identity: the lab files have the transform baked into the vertices). The lab GLBs are the ASHLAR source GLBs rescaled to real size (uniform k), with a baked yaw, re-pivoted to the bottom centre. The optimized GLBs referenced by "file" are in the SOURCE frame (about 1 m, Tripo yaw), so to place an optimized GLB like the lab: scale = scaleForOptimizedGlb (= scale * labFromOptimized.uniformScale) and add the baked yaw of the lab file (labFromOptimized.horizontalExtents says if it is a quarter turn; 180 deg and small squaring yaws are not recoverable from bboxes). position.y is the resolved ground / deck height of the object origin (bottom centre). kind "blockout" / "procedural" assets have no GLB: the lab draws a box shape / card; shape and def size are in assets.
